anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: Gorah Elephant Camp: Colonial Safari Luxury & Wild Encounters in Addo National Park
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Immerse yourself in the timeless elegance of Gorah Elephant Camp, a luxurious tented lodge nestled within the malaria-free Addo Elephant National Park. Experience unparalleled wildlife encounters, including frequent elephant sightings from the main lodge deck. Our colonial-style suites offer refined comfort, while all-inclusive dining provides exceptional culinary journeys. With expert rangers leading daily game drives and a serene, adult-oriented atmosphere, Gorah offers an authentic and unforgettable safari adventure, blending historical charm with the raw beauty of the African bush. Discover a sanctuary where luxury meets the wild heart of Addo.
